<patch operator="ReplaceSubtree" anchor="geofence_guard"><subtree><ReactiveFallback name="geofence_guard">
  <IsInsideGeofence margin_m="{@margin_m}" />
  <Sequence>
    <WaitSimTime duration_s="{wait_time}" />
    <Fallback>
      <GoToRequiredGoal velocity="{rec_vel}" timeout_s="60.0" arrive_tol_m="1.5" />
      <ReturnToLaunch timeout_s="120.0" velocity="{rec_vel}" arrive_tol_m="2.0" />
    </Fallback>
  </Sequence>
</ReactiveFallback></subtree><tunable_ports><port name="wait_time" min="1" max="20" initial="5" /><port name="rec_vel" min="2" max="8" initial="5" /></tunable_ports><rationale>Replace the geofence guard with a ReactiveFallback. If the vehicle is blown outside the geofence, it will wait out the gust using WaitSimTime, then attempt to fly back towards the required goal or launch point. Once it re-enters the geofence, IsInsideGeofence succeeds, aborting the recovery and resuming the mission.</rationale></patch>
